findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous API usage overview
 * @description Finds eval/exec/pickle/yaml/os.system/subprocess/tempfile usage
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dangerous-apis
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string what
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() and what = "pickle"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load", "full_load"]).getACall() and what = "yaml"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() and what = "marshal"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall() and what = "os-cmd"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_output", "check_call"]).getACall() and what = "subprocess"
    or
    call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() and what = "code-exec"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["mktemp"]).getACall() and what = "tempfile-mktemp"
  )
select call, what
findings.hypothesis: General dangerous API usage (code execution, command execution, unsafe deserialization, insecure temp files)

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Redirect-sensitive header strip list contents
 * @description Shows which headers urllib3 strips on cross-host redirects (DEFAULT_REMOVE_HEADERS_ON_REDIRECT)
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redirect-strip-list
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-200
 */
import python

from StrConst s
where
  s.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%util/retry.py") and
  s.getText().toLowerCase().regexpMatch(".*(cookie|authorization|proxy|content).*")
select s, "redirect-related header string literal: " + s.getText()
findings.hypothesis: Check whether Cookie/Authorization headers are in the default redirect strip set for 1.26.17 (CVE-2023-43804).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name 303 redirect body handling
 * @description Finds assignments to body/method in connectionpool.py to check whether request body is dropped on 303 redirects
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redirect-303-body
 */
import python

from Assign a
where
  a.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "connectionpool.py" and
  a.getATarget().(Name).getId() in ["body", "method", "redirect_location", "headers"]
select a, "assign to " + a.getATarget().(Name).getId() + " at line " + a.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: urllib3 1.26.17 keeps the request body when following a 303 See Other redirect (CVE-2023-45803)

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name body assignments in urlopen
 * @description Finds assignments to body and method within connectionpool.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/body-assign
 */
import python

from AssignStmt a, Name n
where
  a.getATarget() = n and
  n.getId() in ["body", "method", "url", "headers", "retries"] and
  a.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "src/urllib3/connectionpool.py" and
  a.getLocation().getStartLine() >= 780
select a, "assign to " + n.getId() + " at line " + a.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: CVE-2023-45803: urllib3 1.26.17 does not clear the request body on a 303 redirect, causing the request body to be forwarded in the subsequent GET request.

 * @name Literals near 303 redirect handling
 * @description Dumps string literals in the redirect handling region of connectionpool.py
 * @kind problem

 */
import python

from StrConst s
where
  s.getLocation().getFile().getBaseName() = "connectionpool.py" and
  s.getLocation().getStartLine() >= 815 and
  s.getLocation().getStartLine() <= 900
select s, "literal at line " + s.getLocation().getStartLine().toString() + ": " + s.getText()
